---
title: "Evolving motifs"
subtitle: "New motifs that morph between originals"
---

Here only every fourth motif is an original from the book; they act as anchors. The three motifs in between are new: the computer generates a quarter of a motif from the patterns of the two anchors on either side and mirrors it into a fully symmetric figure. The first new motif borrows mostly from the left anchor and the last mostly from the right, so the banner slowly changes character as it goes.

This version invents the most, about a third of all stitches, and is the one to watch for a banner that evolves over its length. The new motifs are still rougher than the originals.

```{=html}
<div class="banner-viewer" data-method="evolve"></div>
<script src="../js/banner-viewer.js"></script>
```
